name: NSQ
description: Realtime distributed messaging platform for decoupling and scaling services.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    command: /nsqlookupd
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
  {{serviceName}}-nsqd:
    image: nsqio/nsq:v1.3.0
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-nsqd
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: "/nsqd --lookupd-tcp-address={{serviceName}}:4160"
  {{serviceName}}-nsqadmin:
    image: nsqio/nsq:v1.3.0
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-nsqadmin
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: "/nsqadmin --lookupd-http-address={{serviceName}}:4161"
